scenarios.title: A creature with intimidate can be blocked only by artifact creatures and creatures sharing a color with it
decisions: A attacks player B with Bladetusk Boar.
B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Bladetusk Boar.

variants.label: green_blocker
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears (green, not an artifact) as a blocker of Bladetusk Boar (red) is illegal; Grizzly Bears is not among Bladetusk Boar's legal blockers.

variants.label: same_color_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Hill Giant (red) as the blocker instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Declaring Hill Giant as a blocker of Bladetusk Boar is legal.

variants.label: artifact_blocker
variants.delta: B declares Phyrexian Walker (a colorless artifact creature) as the blocker instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Declaring Phyrexian Walker as a blocker of Bladetusk Boar is legal.
